Bubble sort, step by step

Bubble sort walks the array again and again, compares each pair of neighbors and swaps them when they are out of order. After each pass the largest value left has bubbled to the end.

Click the figure, then use ← →, space, Home and End, or the buttons.

How it works

  1. Compare the first two values. If the left one is larger, swap them.
  2. Move one step right and repeat until the end of the unsorted part.
  3. The largest unsorted value is now last. Mark it sorted.
  4. Repeat with one less value until everything is sorted.

Cost

Time
O(n²) compares. With an early exit when a pass makes no swaps, O(n) on sorted input.
Space
O(1): it sorts in place.
Stable
Yes: equal values keep their order.

The code behind this figure

Nothing here is hand-animated. The figure comes from this code: a plain bubble sort with stepthru tracer calls, such as compare and swap, that record each step.
